get.description:
Return the caller's user + workspace + role from the access token.

Requires a valid dashboard JWT (not an API key) — it is the "who am I" the FE
calls on reload to rehydrate session state instead of trusting localStorage.

post.description:
Rotate the refresh token and return a new access + refresh pair.

The token may arrive in the JSON body (``refreshToken``) or — for the
httpOnly-cookie flow (BACKEND_BEST_PRACTICES.md §7), where JS cannot read it
— from the ``refresh_token`` cookie with an empty body.
Revoke the presented refresh token. Idempotent — always returns 204.

get.description:
Return a signed state token and the provider's authorization URL.

Accepts an optional Bearer token so an already-authenticated user can link
an additional provider (account-linking). Unauthenticated callers get
``user_id=None`` in the state.

post.description:
Exchange an authorization code for a Brainite session.

Verifies all six state checks before touching the provider. Any failure
returns a generic 401 — never revealing which check failed.

Begin the OAuth flow: return the provider consent URL to redirect the user to.

Subdomain-scoped providers (Zendesk) pass ``{"subdomain": "acme"}`` in the body.

get.description:
OAuth redirect target: exchange the code, store the connection, bounce to the dashboard.

``code`` is optional because a pure GitHub App install redirects here with an
``installation_id`` and no ``code``. ``error`` is set when the user declines the
consent screen (e.g. ``error=access_denied``); the service redirects back cleanly
instead of trying to exchange a missing code.

post.description: Revoke (best-effort) and delete a source connection.

get.description: List provider-discoverable channels merged with persisted selection state.

patch.description: Toggle which channels are selected for ingestion.

post.description:
Receive, verify, and enqueue a provider webhook; respond 200 immediately.

Slack's ``url_verification`` handshake returns a challenge that must be echoed
verbatim so the endpoint can be registered in the Slack app console. Google push
(Drive/Gmail) is content-free and identifies the delivery via request headers /
query params, so both are passed to the service.

Create a workspace for the authenticated user.

Only a valid JWT is required — the caller has no workspace yet (signup
token carries workspace_id=None). Returns a new access token scoped to
the created workspace so the client can make workspace-scoped calls
immediately without re-signing in.

patch.description:
Save onboarding progress for a step.

Caller must be an admin of the target workspace. The workspace_id in the
JWT is checked against the path param so a token for workspace A cannot
mutate workspace B even if the role check passes.

post.description: Kick off the onboarding sweep across all connected sources.

get.description: List reviews, newest first (contradictions surface first).

post.description: Approve a review: apply the extracted change and publish the skill.
Reject a review: record the verdict; demote a review-only skill to draft.
Approve many sweep-sourced reviews at once (declared before /{review_id}).

get.description: One review with full source context (contradiction sources in payload).

post.description: Human writes the correct skill logic directly (publishes at confidence 1.0).
Resolve a contradiction: pick source_a/source_b, or write the correct version.

get.description: pgvector semantic search over published skills.
Export all published skills as a portable markdown bundle (zip).
Full version history for a skill.

post.description: Report an agent override; drops confidence and may open a review.

get.description: Whether the brain is ready to answer for this workspace (FE gate).

BulkApproveRequest.title: BulkApproveRequest
BulkApproveRequest.description: Approve many sweep-sourced reviews at once (PRD Feature 23).

ContradictionResolveRequest.title: ContradictionResolveRequest
ContradictionResolveRequest.description:
Resolve a contradiction card: pick a source as authoritative, or write one.

``source_a`` / ``source_b`` adopt that side's proposed text (from the review's
``payload``) as the new base logic; ``write`` requires ``correction``.

OverrideRequest.title: OverrideRequest
OverrideRequest.description: Report that an agent overrode a matched skill (Feature 15a feedback loop).

ResolveRequest.title: ResolveRequest
ResolveRequest.description: Optional reviewer note attached to an approve/reject.

WorkspaceSettingsUpdate.title: WorkspaceSettingsUpdate
WorkspaceSettingsUpdate.description: Partial update of workspace settings (PATCH semantics).

WriteRequest.title: WriteRequest
WriteRequest.description:
A reviewer-authored correction: the human writes the skill's logic directly.

Publishes at confidence 1.0 (human-confirmed) regardless of the pipeline's
original routing — PRD Feature 21 / Process 6 "Write correction".
